items.distractor_fact: Оның электрондық әмиянында {D} теңге бар болды.
items.gloss_en: Her electronic wallet had a balance of D tenge. No case suffix attaches to the numeral; теңге stays unqualified after any numeral.
items.entity_note: a different instrument (her e-wallet), not a different person's bank account as in the first distractor

items.distractor_fact: Бухгалтердің жеке шотында {D} теңге бар еді.
items.gloss_en: The accountant's personal account had a balance of D tenge. The possessive/locative suffixes attach to шот(ы), not the numeral.
items.entity_note: a different person (the accountant), not another organisation as in the first distractor

items.distractor_fact: Көрші кәсіпорынның сол айдағы кірісі {D} теңге болды.
items.gloss_en: The neighboring enterprise's income for that same month was D tenge. Suffixes attach to кірісі, not the numeral; теңге is unqualified after any numeral.
items.entity_note: a different organisation (a business enterprise), not another family as in the first distractor

items.distractor_fact: Клубтың топ бомбардирі сол маусымда {D} гол соқты.
items.gloss_en: The club's top scorer scored D goals that same season. Гол stays unqualified after any numeral.
items.entity_note: a different person (an individual player), not another team as in the first distractor

items.distractor_fact: Қордың сол айдағы залалы {D} доллар болды.
items.gloss_en: The fund's loss for that same month was D dollars. Доллар stays unqualified after any numeral.
items.entity_note: a different organisation (an investment fund), not another individual trader as in the first distractor

items.distractor_fact: Клубтың көрші алаңында {D} соққымен ойын аяқталды.
items.gloss_en: On the club's neighboring course, the round finished with D strokes. The instrumental suffix -мен attaches to соққы, not the numeral, and that course's own par is never stated.
items.entity_note: a different place (the club's other course, whose par is never given), not another golfer as in the first distractor

items.distractor_fact: Көршінің пәтеріндегі көрсеткіш тақта {D} деп тұр.
items.gloss_en: The indicator panel at the neighbor's apartment reads D, a reading not tied to any ground-floor reference.
items.entity_note: a different person (the neighbor), not another building's elevator as in the first distractor

items.distractor_fact: Топтың жеке ойыншысы сол айда {D} гол соқты.
items.gloss_en: An individual player of the team scored D goals that month. Гол stays unqualified after any numeral.
items.entity_note: a different person (an individual player), not a third team as in the first distractor
